name: Dungeon release: the revived player gets Corpse Runner (84015) to rejoin the group
contract: A player who releases in a dungeon is revived at the nearest dungeon start (AscensionDungeonRelease) and must
walk back to the group. The revive applies the client spell 84015 Corpse Runner: effect 0 raises run speed by
100% (SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED, base points 99) for 60 seconds (SpellDuration). Speed auras do not stack,
the strongest one applies, so the run speed rate is exactly 2.0 even with the optional 15% run speed aura
(86000). The aura's removal conditions come from its own client AuraInterruptFlags. Maraudon Normal from
Landslide's spawn revives at the Pristine Waters start, as in maraudon-wicked-grotto-release-7004.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Maraudon
CONTROL: the hero has no Corpse Runner before dying
CONTROL: the hero stands at the Pristine Waters start
The revived hero has Corpse Runner
Corpse Runner lasts its client duration of 60 seconds
The hero runs at twice the base speed
